Brush JavaScript/WebAssembly runtime.
Built from ArthurBrussee/brush compatibility commit 3b80985709e2ec04fd6c8622a40e36473647a8e0.
360GS extension: v0.3c22 direct differentiable equirectangular camera plus effective-rank Gaussian shape regularization.
c21 ERP projection, analytic Jacobian/VJP, radial depth ordering and complementary seam weighting are retained unchanged.
Effective rank uses covariance eigenvalues s^2 and penalizes rank-1 needle-like Gaussians after 25 percent of browser training.
Regularization ramps to weight 0.02; no smallest-axis thinning term is added because the Mip-Splatting scale floor remains active.
Frontend diagnostics report effective rank and max-to-middle scale ratio so flat disks are distinguished from needles.
SH1, c20/c21 spherical geometry, post-triangulation pose refinement and browser-safe GPU-only growth are retained.
wasm-opt disabled in CI because --converge exceeded hosted-runner time limits.
Brush is licensed under Apache-2.0. Effective-rank method attribution is documented in README/BUILD_VERSION.
